ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT is dated as of January 12, 2006, between The West 17th Street Company, a New York Limited Partnership, having an office c/o Rothkrug Rothkrug Weinberg & Spector, 185 Great Neck Road, #402, Great Neck, New York 11021 ("Owner"), and Rose Realty Groupx LLC, a New York Limited Liability Company having offices at c/o Alfred Caiola, 316 East 63" Street, New York, NY 10021,("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of New York generally known as Lot 1 in Block 793 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 163West 17h Street, Manhattan, New York and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof together with the buildings and improvements presently or hereafter located thereon (collectively, the “Owner's Premises"), the existing building and improvements currently located on the Owner's Premises being collectively referred to herein as the “Existing Building" or "Owner's Building"; and WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of New York generally known as Lots 73 and 76 in Block 793 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 127/33 Seventh Avenue, Manhattan, New York and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof together with the buildings and improvements presently or hereafter located thereon (collectively, the “Developer's Premises") the existing building and improvements currently located on the Developer's Premises being collectively referred to herein as the “Developer's Building", and WHEREAS, Developer may, but shall not be obligated to demolish and/or alter the existing improvements thereon and/or construct a new building (such new building, as the same may be altered, modified, improved or replaced from time to time, the“New Building") on Developer's Premises; and WHEREAS,it is planned that theNewBuilding wili contain more Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is now permitted to be constructed on Developer's Premises pursuant to the ZoningResolution; and WHEREAS,there currently exist atleast13,600squarefeet ofFloorArea Development Rights (as hereinafter defined, the “Excess Zoning Rights") which are appurtenant to Owner's Premises representing a portion of the Floor Area Development Rights which are in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights currently utilized by the Existing Building, and the same are available for transfer pursuant to the ZoningResolution;
